scope: LD8 finite typed model; arbitrary full nested original encoders. Native encoder/projection/publication coupling remains conditional. Logical trace is not a native complexity proof.

roots.name: Reuse035.finish_frame
roots.expected_type:
∀ {np nc : Nat} (s : State np nc) (t : Fin nc) (row : Child np), s.children t = some row →
 (incrementalAfter s t).children t = some (terminalize row) ∧
 (∀ i, i ≠ t → (incrementalAfter s t).children i = s.children i) ∧
 (incrementalAfter s t).parents = s.parents ∧ (incrementalAfter s t).usedParents = s.usedParents ∧
 (incrementalAfter s t).usedChildren = s.usedChildren ∧ (terminalize row).owner = row.owner ∧
 (incrementalAfter s t).commands = s.commands ∧ (incrementalAfter s t).lineage = s.lineage ∧
 (incrementalAfter s t).position = s.position+1

roots.name: Reuse035.view_update_exact
roots.expected_type: ∀ {np nc : Nat} (s : State np nc) (t : Fin nc), advance (rebuild s) t = rebuild (incrementalAfter s t)

roots.name: Reuse035.unaffected_result_stable
roots.expected_type:
∀ {np nc : Nat} (s : State np nc) (t i : Fin nc), i ≠ t →
 ∀ (render : Option (Child np) → CurrentContext → J) (current : CurrentContext),
 rowRecipe render ((incrementalAfter s t).children i) current = rowRecipe render (s.children i) current

roots.name: Reuse035.finish_exact
roots.expected_type: ∀ {np nc : Nat} (s : State np nc) (t : Fin nc), incrementalFinish s t = referenceFinish s t

roots.name: Reuse035.observation_reconstruct_exact
roots.expected_type:
∀ {np nc : Nat} (s : State np nc) (t : Fin nc) (encoders : OriginalEncoders np nc),
 completeObservation encoders s (incrementalAfter s t) = completeObservation encoders s (referenceAfter s t)

roots.name: Reuse035.finish_preserves_safety
roots.expected_type: ∀ {np nc : Nat} (s : State np nc) (t : Fin nc), valid s → valid (incrementalAfter s t)

roots.name: Reuse035.ground_advance
roots.expected_type:
∀ {np nc : Nat} (g : Ground np nc) (t : Fin nc) (row : Child np),
 g.state.children t = some row → representable g.state →
 ∃ child, promote g (expectedParent g) t .applied = some child ∧ child.subject=g.subject ∧
 child.state=incrementalAfter g.state t ∧ valid child.state

roots.name: Reuse035.refusal_no_promotion
roots.expected_type: ∀ {np nc : Nat} (g : Ground np nc) (expected : Expected) (t : Fin nc), promote g expected t .refused = none

roots.name: Reuse035.stale_no_promotion
roots.expected_type:
∀ {np nc : Nat} (g : Ground np nc) (expected : Expected) (t : Fin nc), promote g expected t .stale = none ∧
 (expected ≠ expectedParent g → promote g expected t .applied = none)

roots.name: Reuse035.uncertain_no_authority
roots.expected_type: ∀ {np nc : Nat} (g : Ground np nc) (expected : Expected) (t : Fin nc), promote g expected t .uncertain = none

roots.name: Reuse035.semantic_work_bound
roots.expected_type:
∀ {np nc : Nat} (s : State np nc) (t : Fin nc) (physical : CompletionCharges),
 (measuredFinish s t).1 = incrementalAfter s t ∧ (measuredFinish s t).2 = finishDecisionTrace ∧
 finishDecisionTrace.length = 5 ∧ (finishDecisionTrace.filter (fun x => decide (x=.prefixEvent))).length = 0 ∧
 finishDecisionTrace.length ≤ totalCharges physical

roots.name: Reuse035.fallback_exact
roots.expected_type:
∀ {α : Sort u} {β : Sort v} (ordinary optimized : α → β) (input : α),
 routed false ordinary optimized input = ordinary input
